checks.section_text: 2024 Bikeway and Trail Facilities Plan The City’s complete adopted 513-page plan sets Albuquerque’s bicycle and trail network vision, facility recommendations, project priorities, and implementation guidance, with its supporting appendices and crossings guide. Official City PDF Bicycle and Trail Crossings Guide Provides design guidance for bicycle and trail crossings, helping practitioners select treatments that improve visibility, clarify priority, and reduce conflicts at roadway intersections. Appendix A – Planning and Policy Framework Summarizes the adopted plans, policies, and regulatory context that shaped the 2024 plan’s goals, network recommendations, priorities, and implementation approach. Appendix B – Community Survey Summary (Spring 2023) Reports responses from the spring 2023 community survey, documenting residents’ bicycling and trail experiences, concerns, priorities, and desired improvements across Albuquerque. Appendix C – Project Priorities Survey Map Results (Fall 2023) Compiles mapped results from the fall 2023 priorities survey, showing where participants identified desired bikeway, crossing, connection, and trail improvements. Appendix D – Bikeway Evaluation Process Explains the plan’s repeatable method for evaluating proposed bikeways, comparing corridor conditions, network needs, feasibility, and project priorities across Albuquerque. Appendix E – Bike Boulevard Toolkit Describes planning and design tools for low-stress bicycle boulevards, including traffic calming, crossing improvements, wayfinding, and strategies for managing motor-vehicle volumes. Appendix F – Priority Projects Tables (Jan 2025) Lists the plan’s priority bicycle and trail projects as of January 2025, organizing recommended improvements for implementation and future programming. Appendix G – Project Profiles Presents detailed profiles for selected priority projects, describing corridor needs, recommended facilities, implementation considerations, and each project’s role in the network. Appendix H – Multiuse Trail Considerations (2015 Plan) Preserves relevant multiuse-trail planning and design considerations from the 2015 plan for continued technical reference alongside the updated 2024 recommendations. Appendix I – Bollard Assessment (2013) Documents the City’s 2013 assessment of multiuse-trail bollards, including operational and safety considerations that inform decisions about access-control treatments on trails.
